prompt:
Production Unity enemy Tank sprite animation sheet. Reference defines exact identity silhouette/proportions, redraw the same creature's articulated action frames in that view. Matte dark brown rocky armor, warm pale gray-white sinew, amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera, soft upper-left light. Massive squat broad quadruped with thick layered irregular rock-brown armor boulders, huge pale gray sinewy muscular FOUR legs, blunt low armored head and amber eye slit, broad heavy body. Preserve the reference's wide tank silhouette. No green/red/purple dorsal sacs, no extra limbs or spikes.
EVERY frame orientation: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing bottom-left, nose toward bottom-left, front legs nearest viewer. Keep the same angle in every pose. No turning body or changing camera angle in any row.
FOUR columns and 6 rows, EXACTLY 24 complete full creatures. PORTRAIT canvas width:height=4:6. Each sprite fits central 60% of equal cell, transparent 20% margins all sides. Full bodies MUST NOT touch/overlap other frames. Same body scale and ground anchor through all states. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential heavy WALK frames, four legs take distinct weight-bearing steps, alternating diagonal pairs, subtle weight shift, stable armor. Row3: FOUR IDLE breathing poses, planted feet. Row4: FOUR shockwave WINDUP frames: hind legs brace, front limbs and chest gradually lift a little, ready to pound ground, preserve full anatomy. Row5: FOUR SLAM/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame both front feet firmly strike ground with head lowered, then armored body absorbs impact, shoulders recoil and settles; no drawn shockwave, dust, debris or ground. Row6: FOUR DEATH frames, heavy legs progressively lose support, armor settles flat, head rests, amber eye darkens.
Actual articulated joints and distinct foot placements; no duplicate still frames, no rotation-only or scaling-only simulation. Four consistent legs, one head, same plates. True transparent alpha0 empty pixels and holes. No background/shadows/floor, no text/labels/grid, no particles or projectile.
